# 上传订单信息接口

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /openapi/order/upload:
    post:
      summary: 上传订单信息接口
      deprecated: false
      description: ''
      tags:
        - 在线系统/订单绩效对接
      parameters:
        - name: appKey
          in: query
          description: 企业的appKey，0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
          required: true
          example: '{{appKey}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: time
          in: query
          description: 当前 UTC 时间戳，从 1970 年 1 月 1 日 0 点 0 分 0 秒开始到现在的秒数,1463217187
          required: true
          example: '{{time}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: checksum
          in: query
          description: >-
            SHA1(appSecret + md5 + time),
            三个参数拼接的字符串，进行SHA1哈希计算，转化成16进制字符(String，小写).示例2f13932c4b7c6888b12360a85261a11b8b543f64 
          required: true
          example: '{{checksum}} '
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: content-type
          in: header
          description: ''
          required: true
          example: application/json;charset=utf-8
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          text/plain:
            schema:
              type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                  message:
                    type: string
                    description: 上传成功的订单个数
                required:
                  - code
                  - message
              example:
                code: 200
                message: upload order info success, total = 2
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: 在线系统/订单绩效对接
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/605287/apis/api-10845496-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: http://qiyukf.com
    description: 正式环境
security: []

```
